requiredCalculations: For each of the four body/topology strata, compute block-paired STAGED-minus-DIRECT throughput effects with mean, median, sample standard deviation, range, percentage delta, and win count.
Report treatment means and sample CV across the eight independent JVM replicas for all eight treatments.
Report within-replica CV without treating measurement iterations as independent forks.
Report measured contention and productiveHandleRatio for every treatment. Source count is a fixture control, not a contention measurement.
Evaluate acquisition success, contention movement, idle fraction, and throughput jointly, allowing policy-induced state movement to remain part of the treatment effect.
Compare the direction and practical magnitude of P-core effects with E-core Experiments 30, 33, and 34 without pooling hardware-specific replicas.
Classify every state-22-dominant measurement while retaining throughput as the primary ranking metric.
Audit every Phase 14 completion-gate item and produce the required full Phase 14 report if P-core portability is resolved.
interpretationRules: Do not merge P-core and E-core replicas; compare conclusions and effect direction by hardware topology.
Do not infer measured contention from source count or occupancy centroid alone.

Experiment 34 establishes representative E-core source-topology consistency but does not establish exact complete coverage of all four numerical contention intervals because the retained four-source raw contention mean was unavailable.
If the STAGED candidate is repeatably preferable in all four P-core strata, complete Phase 14 and state whether the all-STAGED upper execution assumption survives with a body-conditioned idle split.
If one P-core stratum reverses or remains materially ambiguous, classify Outcome E, preserve the hardware/topology difference, and name only the smallest affected P-core refinement.
Do not add core type as a production decision-tree axis during Phase 14.
Do not reopen skip, tune contention thresholds, or add a special state-22 escape policy.
If Phase 14 completes, distinguish an execution-action conclusion from an idle-duration conclusion and select the most specific supported Outcome A/B/C/D/E classification.
completionReportRequirements: Title the synthesis 'Phase 14 Findings: High-Contention Execution and Idle Surface'.
Include the exact anchor fixture and coarse execution/idle matrix.
Include balanced order and independent-fork treatment response.
Include throughput, within/across CV, contention, acquisitions, idle participation, dominant states, and state-22 evidence.
Include action-by-idle interaction, local idle refinement, body sensitivity, E-core source topology, and P-core portability.
State whether the all-STAGED upper execution assumption survives.
State the supported body-conditioned idle surface and correct any earlier overclaims.
Audit all fourteen Phase 14 completion criteria and classify the outcome.
Name only the minimum justified next calibration question; do not configure it.
stopRule: Stop after P-core portability analysis. If all completion gates pass, produce the full final Phase 14 report and stop. Otherwise produce the P-core report, identify the smallest unresolved stratum, and stop. Do not execute or configure subsequent calibration.
